cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(AYScript
    VERSION 0.2.0
    DESCRIPTION "AYScript — Logia scripting subsystem (input.vec2 + per-component signals)"
)

# C++ standard follows the root CMakeLists (currently C++23; may move to C++26).
# Do not pin a standard here.

# ---- S2: opt-in compile-time type metadata tables ----
# When ON, SemanticAnalyzer can additionally consult a compile-time
# generated table. The table itself is generated by S2.1; in S2 the
# macro is honored but the table is empty (== runtime path).
option(AY_SCRIPT_USE_COMPILE_TIME_TYPES
       "Use compile-time generated type metadata tables in SemanticAnalyzer (off = runtime TypeRegistry)"
       OFF)
if(AY_SCRIPT_USE_COMPILE_TIME_TYPES)
    target_compile_definitions(AYScript PUBLIC AY_SCRIPT_USE_COMPILE_TIME_TYPES=1)
endif()

# ---- Third-party deps ----
# sol2 3.5.0 (header-only INTERFACE target) + Lua 5.5 (vcpkg)
find_package(sol2 CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(Lua REQUIRED)

# ---- Library sources ----
# Globs cover src/logia/*.cpp (S0 Lexer/Parser/AST/Compiler) and
# src/*.cpp (S1 runtime bridge + subsystem).
file(GLOB AYSCRIPT_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/logia/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cpp"
)

add_library(AYScript STATIC ${AYSCRIPT_SOURCES})

target_include_directories(AYScript PUBLIC
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>
    $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
)

# Public link exposes AYLog, AYGameLoop, AYEntity, AYReflect — the
# adapter header in AYScript references ScriptComponent (from AYEntity)
# and SemanticAnalyzer references ITypeInfo / TypeRegistry (from
# AYReflect). sol2/lua stay PRIVATE so consumers don't accidentally
# include sol.hpp.
# AYEventSystem is already PUBLIC via AYGameLoop; keep an explicit
# PUBLIC link so INT-04 (AYLogiaEventBridge.h → EventBus.h) stays
# reachable even if GameLoop's dep surface changes.
target_link_libraries(AYScript
    PUBLIC  AYLog AYGameLoop AYEntity AYReflect AYEventSystem
    PRIVATE sol2::sol2 ${LUA_LIBRARIES} AYIO
)

# Enable sol2 type & numeric safety checks.
target_compile_definitions(AYScript PRIVATE
    SOL_ALL_SAFETIES_ON=1
    SOL_SAFE_NUMERICS=1
)

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(AYScript PRIVATE /Zc:__cplusplus /Zc:preprocessor)
endif()

# S3.9 — ays-logia CLI. Built when AYScript is built; tests run via
# the unittest target (which forks the CLI as a child process).
add_subdirectory(cli)

enable_testing()
add_subdirectory(unittest)

message(STATUS "AYScript v0.2.0 (Logia 1284 cases + S4.1 signal/connect/disconnect) — see ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/design.md")
